_help: Hand corrections, by Wikidata id. Keys: exclude (true) or include (true: add an item Wikidata classes otherwise), lat/lon (real wreck site), depth (m, negative), heading (bow, degrees clockwise from north), fam (generic model family), note. Always give the reason and a source.

Q2004262.note: Memorial built over the wreck of Q506022 (USS Arizona).

Q544894.note: Raised in 1982; now in the Mary Rose Museum, Portsmouth.

Q190542.note: Refloated in 2014 and scrapped in Genoa.

Q521459.note: Hydrothermal field (Wikidata class not under 'hydrothermal vent').

Q105992189.note: Underwater sculpture museum at 12–15 m, off Playa Blanca.

Q869818.note: Submerged bronze statue at about 17 m, San Fruttuoso bay.

Q1977186.note: Bow section of the wreck (stern ~4 km to the NNE, 3,565 m). The Wikidata point is off Cape Finisterre, where the ship got into trouble.

Q20181784.note: On the reef slope of Sha'ab Abu Nuhas, about 10-30 m; the GEBCO cell gives 73 m.

Q1043906.note: On the reef slope of Sha'ab Abu Nuhas, 18-27 m; the GEBCO cell gives 86 m.

Q3273207.note: Upright on her keel at about 50 m off Pink Gin Beach; the GEBCO cell gives 20 m.

Q2603065.note: On her port side at about 42 m off Larnaca; the GEBCO cell gives 12 m.

Q596282.note: On her port side at about 40-53 m off Batticaloa; the GEBCO cell gives 3,085 m.

Q481485.note: Almost upturned on her starboard side at about 45 m in Scapa Flow; the GEBCO cell gives 35 m.

Q708046.note: The forward section of the wreck (debris fields 1.4 and 2.1 km to the north); the Wikidata point is some 15 km to the east.

Q1031986.note: Centre of the main hull (the bow lies 450 m NNW).

Q2478173.note: The wreck rests on the slope of Wingate Reef at about 30-38 m (the starboard side a few metres under the surface); the GEBCO cell gives 61 m.

Q187425.note: Wreck site from the multibeam survey (the Wikidata point is ~470 m away); she lies on her starboard side, bow to the north-east.

Q1291512.note: Wikidata copies the Yamato's position. Nagato capsized in the north-east of the Bikini lagoon after test Baker (11°35'N 165°31'E) and lies upside down on the bottom at about 52 m; the exact wreck position is approximate.
